title: GTA 6 had its global premiere...
content_text:
GTA 6 had its global premiere at 7 p.m. last night, so I glued myself to a streamer's playthrough and pulled an all-nighter until 5 a.m.
[昨天晚上7点GTA6全球首播，我就开始盯着主播直播游戏，一直通宵看到今天早上的5点钟。]
My alarm finally woke me up. I freshened up, opened my laptop — another work-from-home day instead of a day at the office.
[刚刚才被闹钟叫醒，洗漱了一下把电脑打开。又是居家的一天，而不是办公的一天。]
We've still got 80% of this week's Zhipu token quota left — come up with some tasks that can burn it, and run the maintenance backlog at full scale.
[这周智谱的token还剩80%，你可以制定一些消耗token的任务，之前慢慢治理的任务全量去做。]
Don't wait for my sign-off — make the call yourself and go.
[不用等我拍板，你自己判断后就去做。]
Running everything in one go might trip the 5-hour token cap, so we need a different strategy.
[一次性全量跑可能会触发5个小时的token限额，需要修改策略。]
What I have in mind is small batches going through the full cycle, then another pass.
[我期望的是小批量全阶段循环执行一遍，然后再执行一遍。]
We're not burning tokens for the sake of burning tokens — the point is to distill a solid skill we can reuse later.
[我们不要为了烧token而烧token，而是为了沉淀出一个很好的skill方便以后使用。]
Why doesn't the loop's self-review match what I expected? I figured we'd clean out a lot of redundant docs — a big-bang refactor — but the actual diff feels small.
[为什么这个循环自检跟我预想的不太一样？我预想能清理掉很多多余的文档，有一个大规模重构，但实际改动范围感觉不是很多。]
